svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three from 40 x 40 x 5 stainless angle: one 112 long (back wall)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and two about 190 long (the two end walls); cut each to fit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One leg lies flat on top (the coil sits on it); the other hangs down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld each to the inside of the shell with stainless rod, square to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the wall, before the lining goes in:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back wall: centred, top 410 above the inside of the floor board;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end: 105 in front of the centre line, top about 423 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right end: 105 in front of the centre line, top about 436 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (The coil climbs 40 mm a turn, so the three tops differ.)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each top sits just under the lowest turn of the coil: set the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: final height with the coil in place and shim if needed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the coil rests on all three, level within 3 mm.
